rubrics.justification: The response correctly references the provided 2BB grade and notes partial/full blastocoel filling, but it inaccurately calls grade 2 an expanded blastocyst and provides almost no image-specific discussion of ICM, TE, zona, or overall appearance.
The visible response does not integrate patient age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, smoking, sperm parameters, or endometrium with embryo quality.
Reasoning is very limited and includes a grading inconsistency (calling Gardner 2 an expanded blastocyst), so conclusions are only weakly supported.
Use of Gardner terminology is partially incorrect because stage 2 is not expanded/full blastocyst; otherwise there is insufficient content to demonstrate guideline-based assessment.
No concrete transfer recommendations, prognosis counseling, or future cycle planning are provided in the visible response.
